## What we've covered

By right now you will:

1.	Understand how standardization and decomposition can be used to answer social science research questions
2.	Be familiar with different approaches to standardization and decomposition
3.	Be able to apply standardization and decomposition to practical examples in R or Stata

## Where to go next

- For more methods training: lots more courses by [SGSSS](https://www.sgsss.ac.uk/training/) and [NCRM](https://www.ncrm.ac.uk/training/)
- If you want to do standardization and decomposition you can find the DasGuptR at https://github.com/josiahpjking/DasGuptR and on [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/DasGuptR/index.html)
- These resources will live online so you can find them at https://josiahpjking.github.io/sgsss_std_decomp/ (until linkrot comes for them, as for us all)
